title: Valid Parenthesis String
keyIdea: Track the range [lo, hi] of how many '(' could be open after each character. '(' → both +1; ')' → both −1; '*' → lo − 1, hi + 1. If hi < 0, there are too many ')' → false. Clamp lo at 0. Valid if lo == 0 at the end.

approaches.name: Greedy range of open brackets
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). lo/hi updated per character; fail when hi < 0; lo = max(lo, 0); return lo == 0.

quiz.q: What do lo and hi mean?
options: The fewest and the most '(' that could be open, over all choices for the '*'s
Positions of the first and last '('
A negative count means that choice closed too many; those choices are thrown away

quiz.q: When is the string valid at the end?
options: lo == 0: some choice leaves nothing open
